These terms are governed by the laws of Lebanon, and the courts of Beirut have exclusive jurisdiction.
privacyBody: Account data you give us (name, company, business email, role), messages you send through the contact form, and technical data such as IP address, browser type and pages visited.
To operate your account, respond to licensing enquiries, generate rights and availability documents, secure the platform, and meet legal obligations.
Performance of a contract with you or your company, our legitimate interest in running and securing the business, and your consent where required.
We use service providers for hosting, database and email delivery. They process data on our instructions only. We do not sell personal data and we do not use advertising trackers.
We set a session cookie for authentication and a preference cookie for your language. No third-party advertising or profiling cookies are used.
Account records are kept for the life of the business relationship plus the period required by Lebanese commercial and tax law. Contact-form messages are kept for 24 months.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, and object to processing. Write to us and we will answer within 30 days.
